choices.text: Decide on the spot: unload the driver near his hours limit first and tell the other carrier to wait 40 minutes.
Call both carriers' dispatchers, lay out the constraint, and let them agree on an order before anything moves.
Hold both trucks until maintenance confirms whether Door 4's seal can be patched safely.

response.text: At 7:00 in Stockton, as Logistics Operations Lead at a distribution center off Highway 99, two refrigerated trucks of table grapes pull in at once. Only Door 6 has a working dock seal. One driver is close to his hours-of-service limit and wants to drop the trailer and go.
response.title: Two trucks, one door
